assertions.issues: Group status is 'resolved' (not 'open') because min_sources=1 causes immediate mitigation creation and group resolution in the same request. This is expected behavior per the known quirk: 'With min_sources=1, a single event both creates the signal group AND triggers mitigation.'

assertions.title: Concurrent events create exactly one group

steps.action: Set config min_sources=10, reload (to keep group open for all events)
Send 5 parallel curl requests with different sources for 203.0.113.14/udp_flood
steps.observed: One group created (e3f6f95c), 4 events accepted, 1 event failed with unique constraint violation (race condition)
1 group with source_count=4 (source_1, source_2, source_4, source_5)

assertions.issues: One of 5 parallel requests failed with 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint idx_signal_groups_open_unique' due to a race condition when two requests simultaneously try to INSERT a new open group. The unique index correctly prevents duplicate groups, but the failing request returns a 500 database error rather than gracefully retrying and joining the existing group. This is a minor robustness issue — the core invariant (exactly one group) is maintained.

Event accepted, group a77a8a7f created for syn_flood

frictions.description: Other subagents concurrently modifying configs/prefixd.yaml caused test failures. Between config reload and event submission (~20s), another subagent could change min_sources or enabled, causing unexpected corroboration behavior. Required rapid reload+test sequencing.
frictions.resolution: Combined config modification, reload, and event submission in single rapid shell command sequences to minimize race window

frictions.description: Customer quota (max_active_per_customer=5) was exhausted by other subagents' mitigations, causing corroboration to succeed but mitigation creation to fail with 'quota exceeded: customer (5/5)'
frictions.resolution: Waited for other subagents to withdraw their mitigations, then retested

frictions.description: VAL-ENGINE-026 race condition: One of 5 parallel requests fails with HTTP 500 (duplicate key constraint) instead of gracefully retrying. The unique index on (victim_ip, vector) WHERE status='open' correctly prevents duplicate groups, but the application doesn't handle the conflict with an upsert/retry.
frictions.resolution: Noted as minor robustness issue. Core invariant (exactly one group) is maintained by the unique index.

summary: Tested 8 assertions: 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked, 0 skipped. All signal group lifecycle behaviors confirmed: creation (VAL-ENGINE-001), joining (VAL-ENGINE-002), expiry (VAL-ENGINE-003), resolution (VAL-ENGINE-004), concurrency safety (VAL-ENGINE-026), vector separation (VAL-ENGINE-027), expiry without corroboration (VAL-CROSS-007), and migration integrity (VAL-CROSS-011). Minor friction from concurrent subagent config modifications and shared customer quota.
